name: Pinned OTP node identity observations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - name: Build standalone node identity observation tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - name: Build and attest the pinned development compiler
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_BEGIN $GITHUB_SHA"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch OTP-29.1.1 https://github.com/erlang/otp.git artifacts/beam-otp-source
            source_commit="$(git -C artifacts/beam-otp-source rev-parse HEAD)"
            test "$source_commit" = ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_VERIFIED $source_commit"
            cd artifacts/beam-otp-source
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_CONFIGURE --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et'
            ./configure --prefix="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle" --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_MAKE -j2'
            make -j2
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL'
            make install
            test "$(cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang/releases/29/OTP_VERSION")" = 29.1.1
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL_VERIFIED 29.1.1'
          } 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          log = root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-build.log'
          evidence = {
              'SourceCommit': 'ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5',
              'SourceTag': 'OTP-29.1.1',
              'SourceBuildCompleted': True,
              'InstalledOtpRoot': str(root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang'),
              'SourceBuildLog': str(log),
              'SourceBuildLogSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
              'HarnessCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
              'RunId': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'RunAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'Job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'],
              'RunnerOs': os.environ['RUNNER_OS'],
              'ConfigureOptions': ['--without-javac','--without-wx','--without-odbc','--without-debugger','--without-observer','--without-et'],
              'BuildArguments': ['make','-j2'],
              'InstallArguments': ['make','install']
          }
          (root / 'artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Capture three node identity transitions in fresh VMs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/node-identity artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-node-identity
          path: |
            artifacts/node-identity
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log

-module(node_identity_probe).
-export([run/2]).

run(Case, Output) ->
    put(output, Output),
    save("stage", <<"started">>),
    try
        observe(Case),
        save("stage", <<"complete">>),
        halt(0)
    catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
        term("exception", {Class, Reason, Stack}),
        save("stage", <<"exception">>),
        halt(1)
    end.

observe(Case) ->
    Steps = steps(Case),
    Owner = self(),
    {Child, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun child/0),
    try
        Ref = make_ref(),
        Terms = {Owner, Child, Ref},
        Map = #{Owner => owner, Child => child, Ref => reference},
        Standard = term_to_binary(Terms),
        Local = term_to_binary(Terms, [local]),
        Name = list_to_atom("erl_net_identity_" ++ os:getpid() ++ "_" ++ Case),
        Options = #{name_domain => shortnames, dist_listen => false},
        term("inputs", {Case, Steps, Name, Options, Standard, Local}),
        snapshot("before", Terms, Map, Standard, Local),
        lists:foreach(fun({Phase, start}) ->
                              Started = net_kernel:start(Name, Options),
                              term(Phase ++ "-operation", Started),
                              require_started(Started),
                              snapshot(Phase, Terms, Map, Standard, Local);
                         ({Phase, stop}) ->
                              Stopped = net_kernel:stop(),
                              term(Phase ++ "-operation", Stopped),
                              require_stopped(Stopped),
                              snapshot(Phase, Terms, Map, Standard, Local)
                      end, Steps)
    after
        try
            term("cleanup-kernel", outcome(fun net_kernel:stop/0))
        after
            cleanup_child(Child, Monitor)
        end
    end.

require_started({ok, Kernel}) when is_pid(Kernel) -> ok;
require_started(Other) -> error({probe_start_failed, Other}).

require_stopped(ok) -> ok;
require_stopped(Other) -> error({probe_stop_failed, Other}).

cleanup_child(Child, Monitor) ->
    Child ! stop,
    receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Child, Reason} ->
        term("cleanup-child", {graceful, Reason})
    after 5000 ->
        exit(Child, kill),
        receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Child, Reason} ->
            term("cleanup-child", {forced, Reason})
        after 5000 ->
            term("cleanup-child", timeout),
            error(probe_cleanup_timeout)
        end
    end.

steps("start") -> [{"started", start}];
steps("start-stop") -> [{"started", start}, {"stopped", stop}];
steps("start-stop-restart") ->
    [{"started", start}, {"stopped", stop}, {"restarted", start}].

snapshot(Phase, {Owner, Child, Ref} = Terms, Map, Standard, Local) ->
    save(Phase ++ "-standard.etf", term_to_binary(Terms)),
    save(Phase ++ "-local.etf", term_to_binary(Terms, [local])),
    Child ! {ping, self()},
    Ping = receive {pong, Child, ChildNode} -> {pong, ChildNode}
           after 5000 -> timeout
           end,
    Facts = #{node => node(), creation => erlang:system_info(creation),
              alive => erlang:is_alive(), pid_node => node(Owner),
              child_node => node(Child), reference_node => node(Ref),
              owner_same => Owner =:= self(),
              owner_lookup => maps:find(Owner, Map),
              child_lookup => maps:find(Child, Map),
              reference_lookup => maps:find(Ref, Map),
              hashes => {erlang:phash2(Owner), erlang:phash2(Child), erlang:phash2(Ref)},
              standard_decode => decode(Standard, Terms),
              local_decode => decode(Local, Terms), child_ping => Ping},
    term(Phase ++ "-facts", Facts).

decode(Bytes, Original) ->
    outcome(fun() ->
        {P, C, R} = binary_to_term(Bytes),
        #{same => {P, C, R} =:= Original,
          nodes => {node(P), node(C), node(R)},
          owner_alive => outcome(fun() -> erlang:is_process_alive(P) end),
          child_alive => outcome(fun() -> erlang:is_process_alive(C) end)}
    end).

outcome(Fun) ->
    try {result, Fun()}
    catch Class:Reason:Stack -> {exception, Class, Reason, Stack}
    end.

child() ->
    receive
        {ping, Owner} -> Owner ! {pong, self(), node()}, child();
        stop -> ok
    end.

term(Name, Value) -> save(Name ++ ".etf", term_to_binary(Value)).

save(Name, Bytes) ->
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(get(output), Name), Bytes).

# Original node identity transition observations

Three fresh pinned OTP-29.1.1 JIT VMs capture actual start, start-stop and restart through net_kernel. dist_listen=false avoids listening distribution admission; no connected transport or direct setnode primitive success is claimed.

Record complete standard/local ETF phase bytes, actual node/creation, retained map lookups, phash2, original encoded decode identities, live child ping and monitored cleanup. Start and stop return guards require the requested transition to execute; phase data contains observations, not SDK-derived expectations.

The exporter checks actual source hash, exact declared ordered scenarios, build pin/root/log and installed version before creating fresh output; compiles original source with warnings as errors, captures full disassembly and runs each scenario in a fresh bounded VM. Runtime29/ERTS17.1/JIT attestation and all raw stdout/stderr/exit/completeness/stages/inputs/operations/facts are retained. A complete capture does not mean semantic assertions passed. The report inventory excludes its own report by construction.

Source-only proposal awaiting source peer review, actual target/style/raw-process/CLI refusal controls, publication and original compilation/execution. No Main runtime or term-identity implementation changed.
